prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for an overhead mobile fantasy party racing game about jumping across sea defense tetrapods. Create exactly 6 separate objects in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows atlas, each centered in its equal sized cell with 12 percent empty padding. True transparent alpha background. Camera fixed high overhead three-quarter view, game orthographic, coherent lighting upper-left, painterly premium 3D game art, detailed weathered concrete and wet moss edges. Top row: a broad pale ivory four-legged concrete tetrapod; a golden ochre weathered tilting tetrapod; a violet slate tetrapod with carved circular spiral. Bottom row: a dark turquoise mossy low partially waterlogged tetrapod (object only no sea); a broad circular stone refuge platform edged with aged brass and a small glowing seafoam crystal beacon at the back, clear central landing space; a stone finish refuge platform with two tiny navy and gold pennant poles at its rear. Tetrapods must visibly be massive heavy cast-concrete four-pronged breakwater objects, NOT squares, stars or cubes. Flattened upper central surfaces readable for small characters to land. Each object is isolated, entirety visible, nothing crosses cell edges. No text, no characters, no interface, no checkerboard, no background, no shadows outside own object. Width 1536 height 1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high quality vertical ocean background texture for a mobile overhead fantasy sea platform jumping game. Bird's-eye orthographic looking almost straight down at open jewel teal sea, richly layered deep navy and turquoise water, delicate moving-looking white foam filaments, subtle translucent underwater rocks ONLY along the very left and right edges, soft sunlight golden glints, painterly cinematic premium videogame artwork, natural irregular currents with large quiet areas. Center 80% remains entirely clear open water for gameplay platforms to be drawn on. No land across center, no platforms, no tetrapods, no characters, no boats, no text, no horizon, no UI, no borders. Portrait 1024 by1536.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait premium fantasy game cover illustration, mobile party minigame jumping across tetrapods at sea. Dramatic low aerial three-quarter view of an adventurous winding route of huge weathered four-pronged concrete tetrapods scattered across bright deep teal waves, golden late afternoon light, white sea spray, seaweed, barnacles, two tiny stone refuge islands with cyan beacon crystals and a distant lighthouse finish. One giant tetrapod foreground lower center with a large flat top, many smaller tetrapods receding toward the upper-center horizon and lighthouse. A playful yet epic sense of a longtime rival and a daring obstacle race. Painterly high-detail videogame key art, deep ocean green and warm brass palette, tasteful aged golden maritime border corners ONLY, no UI. Top quarter relatively dark clear storm-sky space to overlay title. No characters (existing game characters are overlaid separately), no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. Portrait 1024 x1536.
